name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Food truck ordering app
promotionalText: Accept pre-orders, protect your kitchen from excess orders, and keep serving when the signal is lost. The ordering app for food truck staff.
description:
HatchGrab is the ordering and kitchen app for food trucks: the tool your team uses to run service.

Customers order first and choose a collection time. Your staff see all orders on one screen, confirm what the kitchen can cook, then mark them ready and collected.

DON’T PROMISE A TIME THAT CAN’T BE MET
Set how much your kitchen can cook at once and how long it takes. When a collection time is full, customers can’t choose it, so the queue matches what the kitchen can do.

TAKE ORDERS DIRECTLY AT THE TRUCK
Add on-the-spot orders to the same screen as pre-orders, so the kitchen works from one queue.

ONE SCREEN FOR THE KITCHEN
The kitchen screen shows what has to be made now, what is next, and what is already ready, with a warning when an order needs to be started.

PRINT ORDER TICKETS
Connect a kitchen receipt printer via Bluetooth or your local network, and order tickets print automatically.

KEEP SERVING WHEN THE SIGNAL IS LOST
Switch on offline protection: if the connection drops, pre-orders are paused so no order comes in that you can’t see. Orders you take on the device stay saved and are synced when you are back online.

MADE FOR THE FOOD TRUCK
Use it on iPhone or iPad. Leave the screen on while serving, get a notification when there is an order that needs confirming, and lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

PLAN YOUR WEEK
Set up your events and locations just once, then take orders for each event.

HatchGrab is intended for food truck business owners and their staff. You need a HatchGrab account to sign in.
whatsNew:
